title: P1 intake audit fixes the first owner and observation-map actions
question: At the first post-P0-R checkpoint, which existing-method inputs are genuinely available, which are missing, and what single candidate-neutral observation intake can proceed without selecting dynamics from static fit?
method: Read the hash-pinned R-192 production-cylinder contract and its ordered owner slots without changing the slot order.
Read the current R-193 and R-200 authority revalidations to test whether static Gibbs/covariance data identify a mobility or heat-root dynamics.
Read the T-059 observation-first contract and classify source hashes, likelihood/covariance, estimator, nuisance, scorer, holdout and prospective-lock fields as filled or pending.
Select one already registered candidate-neutral retrospective estimand for intake only; do not score candidates and do not count the target as prospective validation.
Register the smallest next action and its falsifiers as an append-only research decision under T-061.

exact_scope.forward_owner: R-192 side-16 cylinder, volume 4096, roots k and 2k, unchanged ordered slot audit
forward_available: covariance_bases (R-176 actual A1 k and 2k inverse-transpose roots)
inverse_available: five anchor schemas with roles, source metadata, theory conversion and falsifier fields
six public retrospective packets with lineage and no-retuning flags
F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs stage schema and candidate-card schema
inverse_missing: local source hashes for all anchors
prospective source, lineage, commitment and prediction

identifiability_finding.r193_r200: The same finite static Gibbs density/covariance admits distinct positive mobilities with different heat rates; static fit is therefore non-identifying for the production dynamics.
identifiability_finding.admissible_conclusion: Report an equivalence class or NONIDENTIFIABLE until a source-owned generator, filtration, heat-root map, raw-current intertwiner and q-ledger are supplied.
identifiability_finding.forbidden_conclusion: Do not infer or select TECT dynamics from the static functional, static covariance, or a fitted observation anchor.

candidate_neutral_estimand.nuisance: Intrinsic emission lag remains a separate nuisance distribution.
candidate_neutral_estimand.likelihood_rule: Retain the raw GW/GRB timing likelihood or covariance; do not Gaussianize a derived speed interval.
candidate_neutral_estimand.role: Candidate-neutral retrospective intake only; no prospective credit.
candidate_neutral_estimand.candidate_use: Each candidate may map its propagation law to this estimand only after F_eff/F_obs admission and with its own uncertainty budget.

finding: The unchanged forward method reaches a hard owner boundary at R-192 heat_root_incidence, with only covariance_bases mapped and the remaining production slots absent. R-193/R-200 independently prevent static-to-dynamic identification. The inverse contract is structurally defined but operationally unsealed: all anchor local hashes, raw likelihood/covariance products, estimator/scorer hashes and the prospective lock remain pending. The smallest admissible P1 move is to intake and hash-freeze HOLD-LC-001 as a retrospective candidate-neutral estimand, while leaving candidate scoring and prospective claims stopped.
decision_reason: This is a bounded P1 intake advance: it turns the active packet into one auditable next action and records the exact stop boundary. It neither changes the established forward proof methods nor supplies a microscopic dynamics, physical identity, continuum limit or empirical prediction.

adversarial_review.check: R-193/R-200 mobility twins share static Gibbs data but have different heat rates; no mobility is selected.
HOLD-LC-001 is explicitly retrospective and the prospective lock remains empty.
No candidate is scored while source hashes, covariance/likelihood, estimator, scorer and F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs completion are absent.
Structural incidence, endpoint telescope and finite reserve fixtures are not relabelled as heat-root, filtration or q-ledger ownership.
The packet points to the existing T-054/T-059 authorities and changes no issued method, theorem order or candidate definition.

assumptions: The four hash-pinned manifests are the current authority versions.
R-192 owner-slot order is immutable for the next production rerun.
HOLD-LC-001 remains a public retrospective source and cannot earn prospective credit.
A source hash and exact likelihood/covariance product must be obtained before the estimand is considered frozen.
missing_assumptions: A complete source-owned production dynamics satisfying the R-192 owner contract.
A local hash-pinned HOLD-LC-001 source packet and timing likelihood/covariance.
A defensible intrinsic-lag nuisance law and numerical error budget.
A complete admitted candidate map through F_reg, F_lim, F_eff and F_obs.
An opaque prospective target and commitment after candidate/map/scorer freeze.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing P1 intake evidence. No new theorem, result, negative result, tier change, physical-vacuum sign, Pre-A, Sector-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum or mass-gap claim follows.
decision_scope: Existing-method owner-slot and inverse-input audit plus one retrospective estimand intake selection; no candidate scoring and no new finite mobility variant.
evidence_level: T0 / finite interface and repository-contract audit
next_action: Hash-freeze the exact HOLD-LC-001 source packet, estimator definition, units, timing likelihood/covariance, intrinsic-lag nuisance and lineage; run only the existing schema/lineage validator. In parallel, do not rerun R-192 until a new source-owned heat-root/current/q-ledger hash exists.
stop_or_redesign: If the exact timing likelihood/covariance or intrinsic-lag nuisance cannot be justified, mark HOLD-LC-001 INTAKE_BLOCKED.
If uncertainty exceeds candidate separation, mark the intake UNDERPOWERED and do not score.
If no complete source-owned forward map exists, keep empirical scoring stopped.
If the owner hash is absent, park the R-192 branch and do not add equivalent mobility variants.
non_claims: No candidate is admitted or selected.
No retrospective target is prospective evidence.
No observation anchor replaces the Reading-H physical-empty branch.
No Pre-A, Sector-A, C6, A13, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap statement is established.
